question: Can Hermit deterministically build a Haskell package whose native parallel GHC build is non-reproducible due to GHC's concurrency-enabled nondeterminism (the DRB 2024 unsolved frontier class)?
answer: Yes, for the concurrency Hermit determinizes: `ghc --make -j8 +RTS -C0` is non-reproducible natively (3/3 distinct aggregate hashes) but bitwise-reproducible under `hermit run --strict` (3/3 identical). GHC's own RTS context-switch ticker (`-C`) and multi-capability (`-N>1`) scheduling remain open Hermit determinization gaps.

hermit.product_fix: detcore clock_getres now accepts a NULL res pointer (kernel-faithful), unblocking GHC RTS getCurrentThreadCPUTime probe under hermit

reverie.state: unchanged (Hermit-only change); reverie not checked out in slot 230

host.note: Host-built hermit binary runs inside the container via ld-linux + host glibc staged in /work/hostlibs (harness/hermit.sh); HERMIT_BIN points at the staged binary.

workload.shape: 40 leaf modules + 5 group aggregators + Main; wide independent module graph to maximize -jN scheduling divergence

method.canonical_path: /work/out (fixed every run; eliminates GHC's -o path hashing confound)
method.fingerprint: sha256 over (all .o sorted by name) + final binary, hashed OUTSIDE the hermit boundary from the persistent /work bind mount

key_results.hermit_strict_-j8_default: NON-REPRODUCIBLE (3 distinct) -- RTS ticker still fires
key_results.hermit_strict_-j8_+RTS_-N8: NON-REPRODUCIBLE (3 distinct) -- multi-capability genSym ordering not determinized

mechanism: GHC's global Unique supply (genSym atomic counter) is consumed in thread-interleaving order under concurrency; the order leaks into local info-table symbol names of the form c<base62>_str. symbol_nondeterminism_sample.txt shows 20 such names differing in a single leaf .o across two native -C0 runs.
residual_gaps: GHC RTS context-switch ticker (-C, default 20ms) is a green-thread preemption timer hermit does not yet determinize; disable with the semantics-preserving +RTS -C0 to expose the concurrency hermit does determinize.
Multi-capability RTS (-N>1) parallel genSym ordering is not determinized even under --strict -C0.
hermit run --strict --sequentialize-threads with the GHC threaded RTS livelocks/hangs (consistent with the min-vtime blocking-via-polling livelock).
